coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mariposa Park
names: Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P26
record.summary: Mariposa Park, a park on the north side of Mariposa Street between Owens and 4th Streets, which a photo caption on OCII's open-space page labels 'P26 Mariposa Park'. Its outline is the union of Assessor lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006, three of the four lots OCII's Long-Range Property Management Plan names for parcel P26 (the plan also lists part of lot 8723007, which the outline leaves out). An undated Rec and Park page says the park includes a playground, picnic area, trellis area and lawn and that, as of July 1, 2023, the department will assume its management and maintenance. No source read gives an opening date.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is the union of Assessor lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006 (8,217 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lots and can sit a little off the park's own edge. OCII's Long-Range Property Management Plan (Attachment A, row 32) lists parcel P26 on lots 8723-003, 004, 006 and 007(p); this outline leaves out the part of lot 8723007 the plan lists, because the plan does not say which part. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the open ground left between street centerlines and neighbouring mapped shapes (hand-picked, not a surveyed parcel); 70% of that outline lies inside the lots and it covered 100% of them. That earlier outline also took in the parking lot to the north, which is part of lot 8723008 and is no longer in this record.
notes.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006 (mapped 2001-03-20, 2003-02-05; active), joined into one outline; the earlier outline came from: Traced as the leftover open ground between DataSF's official street centerlines and neighbouring mapped shapes near the UCSF Medical Center campus. Of the separate pieces this left, Pier & Point picked by hand the one showing an oval running track and central field (clearly visible on satellite imagery) as its real extent (it was then labelled P27); not taken from a surveyed parcel.

changes.text: OCII's plan lists Park P26 on lots 8723-003, 004, 006 and 007(p), on the north side of Mariposa between Owens and 4th Streets, and Park P27 on lot 8723-002, at the northwest corner of Owens and Mariposa Streets. This outline is the union of lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006, so it is parcel P26, and a photo caption on OCII's Mission Bay South open-space page reads "P26 Mariposa Park". The page is renamed Mariposa Park (it was labelled P27) and the old address redirects. The shape, status and use are unchanged.

changes.text: Potrero View reported in March 2016 that Mariposa Park would open "this spring" (an expected date); no source read dates the actual opening.
P27 no longer shows a 'complete, September 2026' date. It rested only on Pier & Point's own reading of satellite imagery of an oval that is probably Mariposa Park (P26); no source says P27 was built.
P27 now uses its Assessor lot lines.

A September 2026 accuracy check found that nothing supports labelling the traced oval track as OCII parcel P27. It sits where Mariposa Park is (Potrero View, 2016-03-19, and SF Rec & Park's Mariposa Park page), OCII numbers Mariposa Park P26, and OCII's September 2023 deck lists P27 as not yet built. The record's name, map shape, status (complete) and 2026-09 milestone have not been changed; the identity question is noted on the record and remains open. The OCII deck's title no longer says 'CAC Item 2' (that came from its file name), and the aerial photo credit names only the Wikimedia Commons username Firstcultural.

open_questions: No source read gives Mariposa Park an opening or completion date. Potrero View (March 19, 2016) wrote "When it opens this spring" (an expected date, written before the opening); an undated Rec and Park Mariposa Park page describes the park and says the department will assume its management and maintenance as of July 1, 2023, and the City's June 30, 2023 announcement says Rec and Park would oversee it from July 1, 2023 (an announced date; the announcement is dated the day before).

OCII's plan lists parcel P26 on lots 8723-003, 004, 006 and 007(p) and gives 87,556 sq ft; the three whole lots in this outline total about 88,443 sq ft, and the plan does not say which part of lot 8723007 it means. Whether any of the park lies on lot 8723007 is not established, so that part is left out.
